author: vladimir_ea
content: the payload for such a block will be rejected later in the slot?  it occurred to me reading this that under the circuit breaker proposals all a malicious builder has to do is submit once via relays and then send in a bad gas limit (or any invalid payload) and all builders that ever used a relay are banned.  So relays would probably be advised under Gloas to only accept blocks from known / trusted builders and stop being open to all.

author: nflaig
content:
it's impossible to build a valid payload with such a gas limit, but there are 1000x other ways to build an invalid payload

`all builders that ever used a relay are banned` I wouldn't make too many assumptions based on that, our circuit breaker doens't do this right now and I am not convinced it will do this as you noted, it's set bad incentives for builders/relays to game the system, eg. by setting up multiple urls, using various different builder indices, sybil attacks, etc. etc. I will not implement anything that can be gamed anyways

author: vladimir_ea
content: I was working off this: "The point of this list is that every time that a payload is failed to be delivered by a builder index, an entry in the FailedBuilder list is added/updated, but also another entry is created by any other builder that is served by the same relay, so as to ban the relay as if it were a single builder." (https://www.potuz.net/posts/gloas-circuit-breaker/) which i realise is not a spec and will not necessarily supported  in all clients, but Ithere seemed to be at least some support for this idea (I do not support).
